text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Inquiry into disappearance of Piper Lance aircraft; tiny aircraft disappeared in storm on flight between Tunisia and Malta in December 1995.

- Workers at international security printing firm Thomas De La Rue vote to go on four-day week and get paid for a day less; decision means 63 workers temporarily dismissed can return to jobs; firm is suffering a lack of orders.
- Maltese club in Sydney risks closure over financial problems.
